segments.title: Which animal CAN'T taste sugar?
segments.say: Which animal can't taste sugar? A dog, a cat, or a horse? Comment your guess. Three. Two. One.

segments.title: The CAT!
segments.say: The cat! Your cat has never tasted sweet.

segments.title: Its sweet GENE is broken
segments.sub: Part of the **sweet-taste gene** is missing
segments.say: Part of its sweet taste gene is missing, so it can't build the sweet sensor.

segments.title: Chickens can't taste it EITHER
segments.sub: Source: **Monell Center** study, via Scientific American
segments.say: Chickens are missing the sweet gene too.
Follow for Weird Animal number 18 tonight.
